question: Using a rectangular envelope spanning longitudes 4.3 to 4.6 and latitudes 50.3 to 52.0 degrees (WGS84), list the ICAO code, name and type of every airport that falls inside it, ordered alphabetically by ICAO code.
sql: SELECT icao_code, name, type FROM airports WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(4.3, 50.3, 4.6, 52.0)) ORDER BY icao_code;

question: Compute the bounding box of all populated places flagged as world cities and report it as a GeoJSON polygon.
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS bbox_geojson FROM populated_places WHERE is_world_city = TRUE;

question: How many populated places with a maximum population of at least 5,000,000 lie within the box bounded by longitudes 100 and 145 and latitudes -45 and 5? Report the count and the mean maximum population in that box rounded to the nearest whole person.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_places, ROUND(AVG(pop_max)) AS avg_pop_max FROM populated_places WHERE pop_max >= 5000000 AND ST_X(geometry) BETWEEN 100 AND 145 AND ST_Y(geometry) BETWEEN -45 AND 5;

question: Determine the longitude range spanned by all populated places in Turkey, then list the name and IATA code of every 'major' airport whose longitude falls inside that range, ordered by name.
sql: WITH tr_extent AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS e FROM populated_places WHERE iso_a2 = 'TR') SELECT a.name, a.iata_code FROM airports a, tr_extent WHERE a.type = 'major' AND ST_X(a.geometry) BETWEEN ST_XMin(tr_extent.e) AND ST_XMax(tr_extent.e) ORDER BY a.name;

question: Find every populated place flagged as a world city that lies within 300 km of Los Angeles Int'l airport (at -118.4025, 33.9442), measuring geodesic distance on the spheroid. Restrict candidates to the box from longitude -125 to -110 and latitude 30 to 40 before measuring. Return the place name, its maximum population, and the distance in kilometres rounded to one decimal, ordered by distance then name.
sql: SELECT p.name, p.pop_max, ROUND(ST_Distance_Spheroid(ST_Point(-118.4025, 33.9442), p.geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS distance_km FROM populated_places p WHERE p.is_world_city = TRUE AND ST_X(p.geometry) BETWEEN -125 AND -110 AND ST_Y(p.geometry) BETWEEN 30 AND 40 AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Point(-118.4025, 33.9442), p.geometry, 300000) ORDER BY distance_km, p.name;

question: For each airport category, compute the geographic bounding box containing all of its airports and report the category name together with that envelope as WKT, ordered by category name.
sql: SELECT type, ST_AsText(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS bbox_wkt FROM airports GROUP BY type ORDER BY type;
